text:
eva-partnerships: Quick sync: marketplace listing scheduled to go live Tue May 12 10:00 PDT. Need to coordinate press embargo, partner blog, landing page, and partner badges. Can we confirm final assets + embargo time? cc @lee-press @sam-marketing @nina-seo @jordan-product

lee-press: We have a draft embargo email to press/partners. Proposed embargo lift 10:00 PDT. Need CEO quote and availability for a 10:15 live check. PR draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/marketplace-pr-draft. Attachments uploaded to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood/press/marketplace-kit-v3.zip :thumbsup:

sam-marketing: Landing page draft is here: https://notion.so/redwood/marketplace-landing-draft. Trim hero copy to one line and add partner logos row. Who is collecting final logo files? Also can we get 2 hero variants for a small A/B?

nina-seo: For SEO, we need canonical link + JSON-LD structured data for Marketplace schema. I'll add the JSON-LD snippet to the staging page. Also propose a pre-launch crawl 24h before publish and a sitemap ping at publish.

jordan-product: Feature bullets and SSO notes updated in the doc. Confirming we'll call out Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and the SLA. Need to lock example customer quote (CloudScale).

eva-partnerships: I'll gather logos from partners and confirm permissions by EOD Thu. Two partners need co-review on quotes: CloudScale and OrbitOps. @lee-press can you ping Legal for quote approvals?

release-bot: Created ticket PL-4722: "marketplace-launch-ops-checklist". Checklist items:
- final assets uploaded to S3
- press embargo email scheduled
- landing page staging link live
- DNS & redirect check
- analytics & UTM tags verified
Link: https://jira.redwood/browse/PL-4722

sam-marketing: Quick status: hero variants done, awaiting logos + final quote. ETA logos Thu COB, quote by Fri 09:00. Also added GA4 events and UTM conventions to the doc.

lee-press: I'll ping Legal and the CEO for quote signoff. Draft embargo text to partners: "Embargo lift at 10:00 PDT on May 12. Please do not post publicly before that time." Will paste final email copy shortly.

eva-partnerships: Small ask — hardware partner logos require different sizes and alt text. @nina-seo can you share an alt-text template we can pass to partners?

nina-seo: Alt-text template: `Partner Name — Verified Redwood Marketplace partner providing inference integrations`. Use that for logos and include `width`/`height` specs in the file request. Also adding recommended filename pattern: `partnername_logo_300x100.png`.

jordan-product: Ops question: default routing for marketplace trials — do we route to Hosted by default with a CTA for Dedicated? That affects copy and telemetry.

sam-marketing: CTA proposal: "Try in minutes with Hosted — or request Dedicated capacity". We'll A/B test with simpler "Start with Hosted" variant.

eva-partnerships: Perfect. Let's meet 09:00 PDT tomorrow for a final sweep. Agenda: assets, embargo email, staging smoke tests. If anything blocks earlier, please flag in this thread.

lee-press: :thumbsup: I'll be there and post the embargo email once Legal confirms.

release-bot: Reminder added: meeting 2026-05-11T09:00:00-07:00 on calendar for participants: eva-partnerships, lee-press, sam-marketing, nina-seo, jordan-product.
